verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1675). Measures the consequence from the code: the Practitioner block of lib/personas-core.ts (comments stripped) names no Program and no paywall; its unlocks line names tickets, bookings, memberships, Journeys and the Market, and each of the first four is a money path in lib/billing/payout-prompt.ts, so retiring a path there fails the promise here; its tools are non-empty and every href opens a page found by walking app/ (route groups stripped, and the walk must find /events/new or the probe is reading the wrong tree), including /settings#payouts, whose #payouts section must exist; the PRACTITIONER intake persona in lib/onboarding/personas.ts and the persona_practitioner tag in lib/traits/registry.ts name no programs; the Practitioner rows of docs/ROLES.md and docs/LEAD-FLOWS.md carry no unquoted paywall or build programs; and the regression test lib/personas-practitioner-promise.test.ts keeps its arms. Fails on main (f7f7d3075) at the first arm. Mutation-fired: a broken tool href, a dropped money path and the old intake line each fail it. Runs in about 0.1 s of CPU.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1675). PREMISE RE-TESTED at f7f7d3075 (main), and it held in the form that matters. Programs are not gone as a concept: ADR-864 brought them back as a Business Space's Channel with a Chapter blueprint (migrations 20270110000000 onward, /spaces/<slug>/settings/program). But nothing puts a price on one: no price column, no product kind, no checkout, and Programs are not one of the six money paths in lib/billing/payout-prompt.ts. So "Host paywalled Programs" on the /partners/join Practitioner card still promised a thing nobody can sell, and the card's tools were empty (`tools: []`), so a verified practitioner had nothing to press. The intake persona (lib/onboarding/personas.ts) said "Spin up a program in minutes" and "Host & build programs in minutes", which a Program's Business-plan requirement makes untrue too. WHAT CHANGED. (1) lib/personas-core.ts: the Practitioner promise names only the live money paths and the rule each runs on: tickets and Market products from any account (ADR-914), paid bookings and memberships from a Space, Journeys from a paid Space (ADR-1397). Its tools now open Host an event (/events/new), List a product (/market/sell), Open a Space (/spaces/new) and Receive payments (/settings#payouts). (2) lib/onboarding/personas.ts: the first reel beat is "Get paid for your craft" (tickets, paid bookings, a Journey people can buy) and the first track line is "Sell tickets, bookings and Journeys". (3) lib/traits/registry.ts persona_practitioner description, docs/ROLES.md System 2 Practitioner row, docs/LEAD-FLOWS.md persona table (which also still said worldwide marketplace), and the docs/BUILD-LIST.md 3.3 note say the same. A docs/CHANGELOG.md line. (4) lib/personas-practitioner-promise.test.ts fails if paywalled or paid Programs reappears in any persona copy (partner cards, intake personas, persona tags), if the Practitioner copy names a Program or a paywall, if the promise stops naming a live money path, or if a Practitioner tool opens no page; all six cases fail on main. No help article named the promise (content/help has no partner-programs page), so none changed. Client gamification and a private Channel are not promised any more, because neither is built for this persona; they stay in BUILD-LIST 3.3. No migration.
